meta.title: Every vendor's bid takes the extended end time

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer moves the round's bid end time with the increase auction time moved later.
The invited QA vendor reads the pricing round.
A second QA vendor reads the pricing round.
